title: Data-Driven Modeling of Molten Chloride Corrosion Using Static Test Data
summary: Models trained on 291 literature-derived static corrosion tests identified salt-preparation information as an important predictor. Encoding preparation with a graded index improved reported predictions, but the analysis is retrospective and does not establish causal mechanisms or operational performance.
ai_technology: Seven machine-learning regressors; chloride salt preparation index
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Repeated five-fold cross-validation and out-of-fold conformal calibration assessed corrosion-rate prediction; the graded preparation descriptor improved model performance.
evidence.unknown: Data are literature-derived static tests with missing and inconsistent measurements; no operational-system evaluation is reported.
evidence.ai_role: Seven machine-learning regressors; chloride salt preparation index
